name: ZT750
tagline: Panoramic modern firebox with an architectural log store base
description: The ZT750 is a versatile, high-capacity hybrid wood stove engineered to function flawlessly as either a freestanding statement unit or a built-in insert fireplace. Cast from premium thick iron weighing 169kg, its main firebox features deep external cooling fins for optimized convective airflow and maximum heat exchange. The widescreen ceramic viewing glass offers an uncompromised, cinematic view of the fire, seamlessly blending industrial durability with modern architectural aesthetics.
features: Substantial 169kg thick cast iron core for heavy-duty thermal performance
Panoramic widescreen ceramic glass panel for a theater-like view of the flames
Dual-purpose functionality allowing for freestanding placement or insert integration
Integrated structural cooling fins along the firebox chassis to optimize airflow
Wide-format design perfectly suited for placement over custom plinths or log stores
